[LCNT.5.4] **The rule binds the author surface, not the
implementation.** The runtime iterates constantly — the match loop,
bounded scans, incremental aggregation — and must remain free to.
[LCNT.1.3] constrains what the language exposes to the *rule author*:
the author must never write a loop or hold a cursor. A proposal must not
be rejected under [LCNT.2.1] on the ground that its implementation
iterates.
